NB 1. Public Works Construction Project No. 17-001, 2017 Curb and Gutter Repairs
NB 1
NB 1 attachment
Recommendation:
Award Public Works Construction Project No. 17-001, 2017 Curb and Gutter Repairs, to Leonida Builders, Inc., of Santa Clarita, California, in the amount of $278,086.00, plus a 10% contingency, for curb and gutter, sidewalk, driveway approach/alley intersection, and pedestrian curb ramp replacement, as well as tree removal/root pruning and authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to sign all documents. This contract is awarded to the lowest responsible bidder per California Public Code Section 22038 (b).
The project involves the replacement of curb and gutter, sidewalk, driveway approach/alley intersection, and pedestrian curb ramp, as well as tree removal/root pruning, in various locations throughout the City of Lancaster to eliminate and minimize trip hazards and improve Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) access. Project locations were identified through Comcate system submittals. Work will be performed in compliance with the City's 2014 ADA Transition Plan, which will include reconstruction of two (2) curb ramps and 2,677 square feet of sidewalk at an approximate cost of $6,000.00 and $21,416.00, respectively. In addition, Non-ADA Transition Plan work (clearing, grubbing and removals; curb, gutter and spandrel repairs; tree removal and root pruning) and contract expenses at an approximate cost of $250,670.00 plus a 10% contingency will be performed.

PH 1. Amending and Restating the Fee Schedule regarding Regulation of Medical Cannabis Facilities
Recommendation:
Adopt Resolution No. 17-25 (the "Resolution"), amending and restating Resolution Nos. 17-04 and 17-16, setting the fee schedule regarding regulation of medical cannabis facilities to offset any impacts the operation of medical cannabis cultivation and medical cannabis manufacturing may have on the city.
The City Council ("City Council") of the City of Lancaster ("City") has adopted Ordinance No. 1019 (the "Ordinance"), which added Chapters 5.56 and 17.43 to the City's Municipal Code relating to the regulation of medical cannabis cultivation and medical cannabis manufacturing. The Ordinance authorizes the City Council to establish certain application fees with respect to a local license pursuant to Chapter 5.56 of the City's Municipal Code and conditional use permit pursuant to Chapter 17.43 of the City's Municipal Code.

PH 3. Amendment to Chapter 17.08 of the Lancaster Municipal Code to Establish Regulations for the Grazing of Animals in the RR-2.5 and RR-1 Zones
Recommendation:
Introduce Ordinance No. 1022, amending Chapter 17.08 of the Lancaster Municipal Code to establish regulations for the grazing of animals in the RR-2.5 and RR-1 Zones.
Title 17 of the Lancaster Municipal Code allows light agricultural uses within the RR-2.5 and RR-1 (Rural Residential) zones of the City, which includes the grazing of livestock. However, there are no provisions that establish under what circumstances or situations grazing is permitted. The proposed ordinance would prohibit "free-range" grazing, requiring that all grazing animals be controlled to prevent them from straying onto adjacent property. Grazing would only be permitted to occur on property owned by the owner of the animals, or on property in which the herder has the written permission of the property owner. The owner of the animals would also be responsible for managing the grazing activity to prevent excessive removal of vegetation, and both the owner of the animals and the property owner would be responsible for implementing any dust control measures in compliance with the City code and the requirements of the Antelope Valley Air Quality Management District (AVAQMD).
